record.original_question: Let L^+_1([a, b]) be the vector space of positive real Lebesgue integrable functions on [a, b], where a < b. For (p, f) in L^+_1([a, b]) x L^+_1([a, b]), with f: [a, b] -> [alpha, beta], and for a real continuous strictly monotone function phi: [alpha, beta] -> R, define the generalized weighted quasi-arithmetic mean M_[a,b],phi(p, f) = phi^{-1}((1 / ||p||_[a,b]) * integral_a^b p(x) phi(f(x)) dx). Determine all strictly monotone continuous functions phi, psi: [alpha, beta] -> R for which M_[a,b],phi(p, f) + M_[a,b],psi(p, g) = p(a) f(a) + p(b) g(b) holds for every pair of continuous functions f and g on [a, b].

evidence.quote: Let L^+_1([a, b]) be the vector space of all real positive Lebesgue integrable functions on [a, b] with a, b in R and a < b.
The generalized weighted quasi-arithmetic mean M_[a,b],phi(p, f) of a function f with respect to a weight function p is given by M_[a,b],phi(p, f) = phi^{-1}(1/||p|| integral_a^b p(x) phi(f(x)) dx).

Problem 9.3. Determine all those strictly monotone and continuous functions phi, psi : [alpha, beta] -> R for which the equation M_[a,b],phi(p, f) + M_[a,b],psi(p, g) = p(a)f(a) + p(b)g(b) holds for every continuous functions f, g on [a, b].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$ with $a<b$, and let $L^+_1([a,b])$ denote the cone of positive (a.e.) Lebesgue integrable functions on $[a,b]$. For $p\in L^+_1([a,b])$, set $\|p\|_{[a,b]}=\int_a^b p(x)\,dx$. Let $\alpha<\beta$ be real numbers and let $\varphi:[\alpha,\beta]\to\mathbb{R}$ be a continuous strictly monotone function. For any $f\in L^+_1([a,b])$ with $f([a,b])\subseteq[\alpha,\beta]$, define the generalized weighted quasi-arithmetic mean
$$M_{[a,b],\varphi}(p,f)\;=\;\varphi^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{\|p\|_{[a,b]}}\int_a^b p(x)\,\varphi(f(x))\,dx\right).$$
Determine all pairs $(\varphi,\psi)$ of strictly monotone continuous functions $\varphi,\psi:[\alpha,\beta]\to\mathbb{R}$ such that the equation
$$M_{[a,b],\varphi}(p,f)+M_{[a,b],\psi}(p,g)\;=\;p(a)f(a)+p(b)g(b)$$
holds for every $p\in L^+_1([a,b])$ (with $p$ continuous at $a$ and $b$) and for every pair of continuous functions $f,g:[a,b]\to[\alpha,\beta]$.
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search on functional equations involving weighted quasi-arithmetic means returns active work by Matkowski and others on related equality, invariance, and comparability problems, but no source was found that explicitly resolves this particular equation equating the sum of two integral quasi-arithmetic means to the boundary expression $p(a)f(a)+p(b)g(b)$. The status appears to remain unresolved in the publicly available literature.

status_evidence.snippet: Introduces and studies generalized weighted quasi-arithmetic means M_{[a,b],phi}(p,f) and their properties.
status_evidence.claim: The framework of the problem is well established but the specific functional equation does not appear resolved here.

status_evidence.snippet: Treats related functional equations on weighted quasi-arithmetic means.
